scope:
Nonlinear two-control prefix at an m2/m4 double linear resonance.

The first support coefficient q and the second coefficient -q/(10 sqrt(2))
are fixed. Delta and the descending speed vd replace the two corresponding
linear matching constraints; higher support modes remain unknown. All
outputs are finite LINEAR-tail-DN prefixes, never complete closed surfaces.
